description: Update a listing's parcel, pricing, or marketing data, or a lease's suites. Pass at least one group (parcel, pricing, marketing, spaces); send each group whole, not just the changed field. Returns the full updated listing exactly as stored.

hashid.description: Hashid of the listing to update.

marketing.description: Marketing copy to update: headline, summary, title_override, highlights (string[]).

parcel.description: Parcel/address fields to update: street_address, city, county, state, postal_code, latitude, longitude, and optionally unit, lot_size (INTEGER SQUARE FEET — convert acres × 43,560), lot_size_unit (the unit the size was stated in: sqft | acres | sqm | hectares; display-only), year_built, property_type, place_id (from geocode_address — when the address moves, it matches the listing to a building already on file).

pricing.description: Pricing fields to update: listing_type (sale|lease). For a sale set sale_price (dollars), or omit it and set price_on_request=true for "price upon request". A lease is priced per suite (see spaces); lease_rate_period (per_sqft_year|per_sqft_month|per_month|per_year, default per_sqft_year) is the basis every suite's rate is quoted in. A lease with at most one suite, such as a whole building leased as one, can instead be priced here: lease_rate and available_sqft (INTEGER SQUARE FEET), or price_on_request=true, set that one suite, creating it when there is none. Optionally expires_at (ISO date).

spaces.description: A lease's suites, as the whole list: a suite left out is removed, and an empty list removes them all. A whole building leased as one is a single suite. To change suites, start from the spaces get_listing returns to you as the owner: a suite sent with its id is updated, and any field it leaves out keeps its stored value; a suite without an id is added. Publishing a lease needs at least one available suite with available_sqft and a lease_rate or price_on_request=true.

available_date.description: ISO date the suite is available from.

available_sqft.description: Available space in INTEGER SQUARE FEET.

id.description: The suite's id, as get_listing returns it to you as the owner. Omit to add a suite.

lease_rate.description: Asking rate in the listing's lease_rate_period basis, e.g. 24.5 for $24.50/SF/yr. Null when quoted on request.

lease_type.description: How operating expenses are split: nnn, fsg (full service gross), mg (modified gross), or gross.

max_term_months.description: Longest lease term offered, in months.

min_term_months.description: Shortest lease term offered, in months.

price_on_request.description: true when the rate is quoted on request.

space_type.description: Use of the space: a value from the space_type attribute get_registry returns.

status.description: available (a new suite's default), pending, or leased. Only available suites are shown and priced.

name: update_listing
title: Update listing
